subject: Session orchestration — hands-on POC dates, sample payload handoff, and redaction guidance
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC orchestration — proposed dates + payload ask

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock in two things for the hands-on POC:

1) A 3-hour working session (interactive) where we'll run prompt review, routing experiments, and a short load smoke test.
2) A handoff of a minimal sample set (ideally 500–1,000 representative prompts + expected outputs) that we can use for routing/qa and redaction verification.

Our team is available the week of Jan 18 or Jan 25. Can you confirm which of these windows works for your team and who from Acme will attend (engineering, product, procurement for procurement steps)?

Quick asks / prep checklist I want to cover before the session:
- Share a redacted sample payload CSV (see suggested columns below)
- Call out any PII/PHI sensitive fields and your redaction rules
- Indicate anticipated average prompt length and peak concurrency targets for the load test

Suggested agenda (working session):
- 0:00–0:30 — Introductions & goals
- 0:30–1:30 — Prompt review + routing policy discussion
- 1:30–2:15 — Hands-on routing + KV-cache walkthrough with your sample data
- 2:15–3:00 — Short load smoke test & next steps

Attachments: redaction_guidance_v2.md (checklist), acme_poc_runbook_draft.pdf (session outline).

If Jan 18/19 or Jan 25/26 works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme AI Platform Team <ai-platform@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC orchestration — proposed dates + payload ask

Hi Logan —

Thanks — Jan 25/26 is much better for our engineering team. Tentatively: Tue Jan 26 9:30–12:30 PT. Attendees we'll send formally, but expect: myself (product), Ethan Cole (eng lead), and Priya Ramesh (data privacy). Procurement (procurement@acme.com) will need the runbook and NDA before we finalize.

On sample data: we can share a redacted set by next Wed (Jan 13). We'll remove direct identifiers but will keep fields that affect routing (e.g., customer_tier, product_area, language). Priya will add notes about what must be removed per our compliance team.

Can your team confirm a preferred format? CSV with columns (prompt_id, prompt_text, customer_tier, language, expected_output) works for us. Also please confirm whether you need expected_output ground truth or just labels.

I’ll have procurement reach out about the contract/NDAs — copying them now.

Cheers,
Sarah Nolan
Product Manager, Acme Corp
sarah.nolan@acme.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC orchestration — proposed dates + payload ask

Hi Sarah —

Jan 26 9:30–12:30 PT works great. We'll plan the working session agenda I shared and will leave room to tweak based on your team’s goals. A few clarifications:

- CSV format is perfect. If you can include an "expected_output" column that will help us run routing/accuracy checks, but we can also accept labels (pass/fail) if you prefer.
- Redaction: the attached redaction_guidance_v2.md has our recommended minimal transformations (hash PII keys, remove free-text PII, keep categorical routing fields). If Priya has additional constraints, we can accept a fully redacted test set plus a synthetic mapping file for joinable keys.
- Load test targets: please give rough concurrency numbers (e.g., 10 QPS, 50 QPS steady-state) and an example peak window. Marissa will lead the load portion; I’m CCing her.

Attachments: acme_sample_prompts_v1.csv (example template), redaction_guidance_v2.md.

Next steps:
1) Sarah to confirm attendees + share redacted CSV by Jan 13.
2) Procurement to confirm NDA/contract path.
3) Redwood sends calendar invite + pre-read by Jan 14.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Logan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC orchestration — load testing window + evaluation set request

Hi all —

Quick operational notes from my side for the load smoke test:
- For the 15-minute smoke test we typically run: 30s ramp, 5m steady at target QPS, 30s ramp down.
- If you expect spikes >100 concurrent, flag that now — we'll arrange a dedicated capacity reservation for the test.

Also request: can Acme send a small evaluation set (50–100 cases) with ground-truth outputs that we can use to validate end-to-end correctness during the working session? This should be separate from the larger sample payloads and can be fully synthetic if preferred.

I’ll prepare the runbook steps and a short pre-test checklist and upload to the shared Drive link.

Marissa
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: acme_poc_runbook_draft.pdf (draft runbook)

From: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, ai-platform@acme.com, Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC orchestration — hands-on session confirmed + NDA link

Apologies for the out-of-order timestamp — confirming that procurement pushed the NDA via DocuSign this morning (link below). We’ve uploaded a redacted CSV (acme_sample_prompts_v1.csv) to the drive with notes from Priya on fields that were removed. Also attached: a small 75-item evaluation set (eval_acme_75.jsonl) with expected labels — marked as synthetic where necessary.

DocuSign NDA: https://www.docusign.com/ACME-NDA/12345
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-poc-resources

Confirming Jan 26 9:30–12:30 PT. One small ask: Ethan may need to step out midday for a customer call; can we keep the agenda flexible so the routing and KV-cache sections are in the first 90 minutes?

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session.

— Sarah
Product Manager, Acme Corp
sarah.nolan@acme.com
